description: Read your Personal Agent Protocol file: the organization name and domain saved for it, whether the domain is verified, the file to publish (the poppy.json a personal agent reads to learn what you let it do) and the address to publish it at. Answers released false until agent protocol files are switched on for your workspace. Read-only. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: get_agent_protocol
